'''Orbis Keln''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Unlike the rest of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who saw the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and their Force views as a threat and thus did not participate in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] efforts to gain an alliance with them, Keln was determined to keep the Voss from allying with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he came to [[Voss]] to uncover the evidence of the ancient history of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the planet. Keln planned on revealing these tablets to the Voss so they'd formally ally with the Republic. However, he was confronted by the Empire in the [[Quel-Dora ruins]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
In the Empire chain quest, "Erasing Evidence" on Voss, as he laid dying, Keln pleads with the player(s) to preserve the ancient tablets, willing to stomach them collecting dust in a Sith archive. The player(s) can choose to either bring the tablets to [[Darth Serevin]] and gain light side points, or destroy them and earn dark side points.
